snippet.title: Castle Forbidden – Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🕯️Out now with a 25% launch discount for a limited time!
🕹️Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672520/Castle_Forbidden/

You came to explore an old castle with your friends. But you ended up trapped inside alone. In this horror game, you must explore the shadows, hide from paranormal creatures, and solve strange puzzles as you search for your friends. Unravel the castle’s sinister past and escape…before it’s too late.


Discord : https://discord.gg/C5EdJXc49V
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/castle.forbidden/
TikTok : https://www.tiktok.com/@castle.forbidden
